results.buy_thesis: EDA duopoly with very high switching costs: revenue $2.3B to $5.3B and FCF to $1.6B, above net income, with a slowly shrinking share count.
results.risk_flags: Goodwill ~27% of assets; FCF dipped in 2024. China export controls are a recurring risk.

results.buy_thesis: Cloud networking leader: revenue $2.3B to $9.0B (~31%/yr) at ROE 28% with no debt. AI back-end Ethernet is a new growth leg.
results.risk_flags: Heavy dependence on a few hyperscale customers; FCF dipped in 2022 on inventory build.

results.buy_thesis: CUDA ecosystem and full-stack AI platform: net income $4B to $120B and ROE 76% in FY2026. Debt-to-equity just 0.05 and shares now shrinking.
results.risk_flags: Earnings fell in FY2023, showing how cyclical demand is; customer concentration among hyperscalers. Capex and revenue are missing from the XBRL extract (FCF shown equals operating cash flow).

results.buy_thesis: Two-sided marketplace with network effects: FCF rose from $2.2B to $4.6B since 2021 with ROE 31% and R&D ~19% of revenue. Cash $6.6B versus ~$2B convertible debt.
results.risk_flags: Growth decelerated to ~10% in 2025 and FCF has flattened. FCF is flattered by stock compensation; regulation of short-term rentals is a risk.

results.buy_thesis: Mechanical contractor for data centers and advanced manufacturing: net income $0.2B to $1.0B and ROE 42%, with FCF at or above earnings. Essentially debt-free.
results.risk_flags: Contracting with limited structural moat; goodwill 16% of assets from acquisitions. Revenue is missing from the XBRL extract after 2020.

results.buy_thesis: Fee-based attorney-in-fact for Erie Insurance Exchange: revenue $2.5B to $4.1B with no down years and FCF above net income every year. Debt-free with ROE 21–30%.
results.risk_flags: Earnings are tied to Exchange premium growth and the 25% management-fee rate set by the board, a governance concentration. No R&D or diversification outside one insurer.

results.buy_thesis: Razor/blade veterinary diagnostics: installed analyzers drive recurring consumables, revenue ~$2.7B to $4.3B at 66% ROE. Share count shrinks every year and FCF reached a record $1.1B in 2025.
results.risk_flags: Growth slowed to 6–8% in 2022–24 as vet visit volumes softened. Cash is below debt; balance sheet relies on steady FCF.

results.buy_thesis: Ecosystem lock-in and services: ROE above 150% and shares down from 17.0B to 14.8B since 2020 with ~$100B FCF a year.
results.risk_flags: Revenue fell in FY2023 and FCF has been flat around $99–111B; debt-to-equity 1.23 from buyback-driven low equity.

results.buy_thesis: Search, YouTube and Cloud compounded revenue from $183B to $350B+ with ROE above 30% and a shrinking share count. Cloud and Gemini give it a second AI growth engine on top of a cash-rich core.
results.risk_flags: FCF stalled at ~$73B for two years as capex jumped to $91B in 2025, so FCF is now only ~55% of net income. Long-term debt rose to $49B, above cash, for the first time in this window.

results.buy_thesis: Power-management chips for AI servers and autos: revenue $0.8B to $2.8B (~28%/yr), no debt and $1.1B cash.
results.risk_flags: Revenue was flat in 2023 and 2024 ROE was inflated by a one-time tax benefit; slight share dilution.

results.buy_thesis: Travel platform with direct-traffic scale: revenue $6.8B to $26.9B and FCF $2.5B to $9.1B since 2021, with very large buybacks.
results.risk_flags: Negative shareholder equity from buybacks; long-term debt $18.7B exceeds cash. Net income is missing from the XBRL extract.

results.buy_thesis: Membership warehouse with unmatched scale and renewal rates: revenue $196B to $303B, FCF to $9.4B, cash $20B and no share dilution.
results.risk_flags: Thin margins and FCF dips in FY2022 and FY2024; no R&D. Premium valuation (not scored here).

results.buy_thesis: Electrical/mechanical contractor riding data-center and manufacturing builds: revenue $8.8B to $17.0B, ROE 35%, share count down ~18% since 2020. No long-term debt.
results.risk_flags: Contracting has limited structural moat and FCF dipped in 2021 and 2025. Backlog is exposed to a capex slowdown.

results.buy_thesis: Azure, Office 365 and Copilot: revenue $168B to $332B with ROE 30% and debt-to-equity just 0.09.
results.risk_flags: FY2026 capex hit $116B, so FCF fell for a second year to $67B (0.5x net income). Returns depend on AI capex converting to revenue.

results.buy_thesis: Government and commercial AI platform: revenue growth accelerated to ~56% in 2025, FCF $2.1B above net income, no debt.
results.risk_flags: Share count up from 2.10B to 2.39B since 2022 and ROE only turned above 15% in 2025.

results.buy_thesis: Custom AI accelerators plus VMware: revenue $24B to $64B and FCF $11.6B to $26.9B with no down years.
results.risk_flags: Goodwill is ~57% of assets and the VMware deal diluted shares ~13%; leverage is high. Net income is missing for several years in the extract.

results.buy_thesis: Robotic surgery monopoly with recurring instruments/service: revenue $4.4B to $10.1B, debt-free.
results.risk_flags: ROE only ~14–16% on a large cash-heavy equity base; capex of ~$1B/yr (not in the extract) puts FCF below net income.

results.buy_thesis: Off-price leader with scale buying advantages; ROE 54–61% and shares down from 1.21B to 1.11B. Debt cut to $1.9B against $6.2B cash.
results.risk_flags: FCF is below net income in recent years (~0.86–0.89x) and dipped sharply in FY2022. Revenue is not captured in the XBRL extract, so growth is judged from earnings and FCF.

results.buy_thesis: Salvage-vehicle auction duopoly with owned land and a global buyer network; FCF grew $0.5B to $1.3B and the company holds no debt.
results.risk_flags: Net income dipped in FY2026 and FCF ran below net income until FY2026. Revenue is missing from the XBRL extract.

results.buy_thesis: Continuous glucose monitoring duopoly: revenue $1.9B to $4.7B with FCF reaching $1.1B and ROE 30%.
results.risk_flags: G7 quality issues and Abbott competition; convertible debt is not captured in the extract. FCF lagged net income in 2021–22.

results.buy_thesis: Family of Apps with 3B+ users; revenue $86B to $201B, ROE 28% and R&D 29% of revenue.
results.risk_flags: Capex jumped to $70B in 2025 and FCF fell to $46B (0.76x net income); long-term debt $59B now exceeds cash. 2022 was a down year for revenue and FCF.

results.buy_thesis: Revenue doubled from $43B to $88B with FCF rising to $17B; telematics and direct distribution give a cost edge in auto insurance. ROE back to 37%.
results.risk_flags: Underwriting results are cyclical: ROE fell to 5% in 2022. Insurance is a commodity product and EVA only just turned positive in 2025.

results.buy_thesis: Off-price retailer with ROE 35–42%, a share count down ~10% since FY2021, and debt cut to $1.5B against $4.6B cash.
results.risk_flags: Revenue growth since FY2022 is only ~5%/yr with one down year; FCF has been bumpy and below net income in FY2023–25.

results.buy_thesis: Observability platform: revenue $0.6B to $3.4B and FCF $0.1B to $1.0B with no down years.
results.risk_flags: GAAP ROE only 3–7% and heavy stock compensation; EVA negative every year.

results.buy_thesis: Industrial distribution with onsite/vending lock-in; ROE 32% and virtually no debt (D/E 0.03).
results.risk_flags: Revenue growth only ~8%/yr with a 3% year in 2024, and FCF has been bumpy and below net income in 3 of 6 years.

results.buy_thesis: Independent ad-buying platform: revenue $0.8B to $2.9B with FCF consistently above net income and no debt.
results.risk_flags: Growth slowed in 2025 with Amazon competing in DSPs; ROE averages ~13% and EVA is negative.

results.buy_thesis: Beauty retailer with loyalty program; share count down from 56M to 44M and no long-term debt.
results.risk_flags: Revenue and FCF have flattened since FY2023 (FCF ~$1.0–1.2B) and ROE is sliding from 64% to 41%. Cash is thin at $0.4B.

results.buy_thesis: Wealth-management and advisor network: revenue $12B to $19B, FCF to $8.3B and ROE 54–71% with aggressive buybacks.
results.risk_flags: Balance-sheet-heavy financial: computed EVA is negative every year and earnings are tied to market levels. No R&D.

results.buy_thesis: AWS, retail logistics and advertising: revenue $386B to $717B with net income at a record $78B and ROE ~19%.
results.risk_flags: AI capex compressed reported free cash flow to roughly $11B in 2025, far below net income (the XBRL extract misses capex, so FCF shown is operating cash flow). FCF was negative in 2021–22 and shares keep rising.

results.buy_thesis: Endpoint security leader: revenue $0.9B to $4.8B and FCF to $1.3B, with $5.2B cash against $0.7B debt.
results.risk_flags: GAAP losses persist (ROE negative) because of stock compensation; growth slowing to ~20%.

results.buy_thesis: Platformization strategy: revenue $4.3B to $11.5B and FCF $1.5B to $4.6B with no down years.
results.risk_flags: Share count rose sharply with the CyberArk deal and goodwill is now 45% of assets; ROE fell to ~1% and EVA is negative.

results.buy_thesis: Jakafi franchise plus Opzelura: revenue $2.7B to $5.1B, net income $1.3B in 2025, no debt and $3.1B cash.
results.risk_flags: Jakafi patent expiry around 2028 is the dominant risk; earnings have been volatile (ROE 1% in 2024).

results.buy_thesis: Premium athletic apparel brand with ROE 32% and shares down from 125M to 111M; no debt.
results.risk_flags: FY2026 revenue growth slowed to ~5% and FCF fell to $0.9B (0.56x net income); U.S. brand momentum is weakening.
